---
description: "Type Traits and Conversions"
---

- Pt-TypeTraits subgroup overview and class-doc override for TypeTraits:
  `include/Pt/Api-TypeTraits.h`
- Compile-time type traits for generic programming (real template implementation):
  `include/Pt/TypeTraits.h`
- Copyable and comparable runtime type information wrapper:
  `include/Pt/TypeInfo.h`
- Source-code location wrapper:
  `include/Pt/SourceInfo.h`
- Pt-Convert subgroup overview (string/number/byte-order conversions):
  `include/Pt/Api-Convert.h`
- String/number parsing and formatting (parseInt, formatInt, parseFloat, formatFloat, narrow):
  `include/Pt/Convert.h`
- Errors thrown by conversion utilities:
  `include/Pt/ConversionError.h`
- Byte-order conversion utilities:
  `include/Pt/Byteorder.h`
- Math helpers and constants:
  `include/Pt/Math.h`
- String-literal pointer utility:
  `include/Pt/LiteralPtr.h`
- Placeholder/void utility type:
  `include/Pt/Void.h`
